The AI Admin PC runs 27 plugins and ~276 non-custom skills - three kits carry 45% of them

Generated 2026-06-06  ·  Source: live session registry (skills + MCP servers)  ·  Scope: all installed plugins and stock skills; Adam's custom skills excluded

27
Plugins installed

Bottom line: coverage is broad and role-shaped - ten business-department plugins, twelve tool integrations, three research engines, four workflow utilities, plus Anthropic's 18 stock skills covering the full document pipeline. The skill count concentrates in three deep kits (Twilio, Small Business, Zoom) that together hold ~45% of all bundled skills. Most plugin MCP connectors sit unauthenticated until first use. Click the arrow on any plugin below for its full skill-by-skill detail. Nothing needs action - this is a reference inventory.

Three developer-grade kits hold nearly half the skill count

Twilio (55 skills), Small Business (31), and Zoom (30) are reference libraries more than daily drivers - deep, narrow, and there when a build needs them. The plugins used most often in daily work (data, engineering, sales, marketing) sit in the 8-14 skill range.

Methodology and data sources

Counts taken from the live Cowork session registry (available-skills list plus connected and deferred MCP server inventory) as of 2026-06-06. Skill counts are approximate where plugins mix skills and slash commands (Twilio 55 including its 8 SendGrid skills, product-management 9 including its brainstorm command). The ~55 MCP connector figure counts per-plugin bundles, so shared services (Gmail, Google Calendar) appear once per plugin that ships them; most connectors expose only authentication endpoints until first sign-in. Point-in-time snapshot - installing or removing a plugin invalidates the counts.
